be_zero_if.raw_floor: analytic sum of terms; cross-checked by a time-domain EVM run of the same cell
be_zero_if.cal_floor: not measured on this chain: the analytic sum with the IQ image at the IRR the calibration runs measured at that bandwidth (a looked-up value)

be_if_extender.raw_floor: analytic sum of terms; the chip's residual in it is measured after the chip's own calibration, which runs when the chain is built
be_if_extender.cal_floor: the same as the raw floor (the chip is already calibrated)

ay.raw_floor: time-domain EVM on the uncalibrated chain, worst constellation (no analytic sum)
ay.cal_floor: measured: time-domain EVM on the chain wifitrx's calibration sequence calibrated
